repos_data.description: Multi-channel content distribution MCP server with idempotent state. Auto-publish to DEV.to, Hashnode, GitHub Discussions, Reddit, Bluesky; browser-fallback for Medium, LinkedIn, X/Twitter.

MCP server to publish to Dev.to, Ghost, Hashnode, WordPress, Medium, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Mastodon from Claude Code. SEO scoring, canonical-URL wiring, social-post generation, Unsplash covers, IndexNow.
Check a social post against a platform's real character limits over MCP. Graphemes, t.co URL weighting, and CJK/Hangul/emoji double-counting -- the things an LLM cannot count by inspection.
